note: WAEC CRS round 10 (R47 top-up): Mary and Martha's good portion; anointing at Bethany; the two thieves; Jonathan and David's covenant; hidden treasure and pearl; the great supper; draught of fishes; the widow of Nain; the Word was God; Rachel weeping; 1 Corinthians 15 resurrection body; press toward the goal; Alpha and Omega; Sennacherib; Simon the Pharisee's sinful woman; the issue of blood; James on the tongue; new heaven and new earth; I AM WHO I AM; Jubilee; Solomon's judgement; render to Caesar; Jesus wept; pearls before swine; ask, seek, knock. Scanned against the whole CRS pool (JAMB, WAEC and NECO stems).

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: When Jesus visited the home of Martha in Bethany, Martha busied herself with serving while her sister Mary sat at his feet listening. Jesus told Martha that
questions.B: Mary had chosen the good portion
questions.D: both should work in the kitchen
questions.explanation: The one thing needful cannot be taken away.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: In the house of Simon the leper at Bethany, a woman poured costly ointment on Jesus' head. When the disciples grumbled at the waste, Jesus said
questions.A: the ointment should have been sold
questions.B: she owed the poor an apology
questions.C: she had anointed him for burial
questions.D: Simon had planned it badly
questions.explanation: The fragrance of her deed still fills the gospel.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: Two criminals were crucified with Jesus, one on his right and one on his left. One of them mocked him, but the other
questions.D: asked to be remembered in his kingdom
questions.explanation: 'Today you will be with me in Paradise.'

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: The friendship covenant between David and Jonathan, in which Jonathan stripped himself of his robe, sword and bow and gave them to David, showed that Jonathan
questions.B: loved David as his own soul
questions.D: was leaving his father's house for ever
questions.explanation: The heir gave his all to his friend.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: In one short pair of parables, Jesus likened the kingdom of heaven to treasure hidden in a field and to a merchant seeking
questions.D: barley loaves
questions.explanation: Both men sold everything to gain the one thing.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: In the parable of the great supper, the invited guests all made excuses, so the master ordered his servant to
questions.A: sell the food in the market
questions.C: postpone the feast for a year
questions.D: bring in the poor and maimed
questions.explanation: The empty places were filled from the streets.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: When Jesus taught from Simon's boat and then told Peter to let down the nets, the catch of fish was so great that the nets began to break. Peter's reaction was to
questions.A: bargain over the price of the fish
questions.B: fell at Jesus' knees, a sinner
questions.C: send for his partners at once
questions.D: ask Jesus to leave the boat
questions.explanation: A fisherman knelt before the Lord of the sea.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: As Jesus approached the gate of Nain with his disciples, a widow was carrying out her only son to burial. Jesus
questions.A: asked the crowd for a collection
questions.B: walked on the other side of the road
questions.C: touched the bier and raised the young man
questions.D: told the widow to wait for Peter
questions.explanation: 'Young man, I say to you, arise.'

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.topic: The Birth and Early Ministry of Jesus
questions.q: The Gospel of John opens by declaring that in the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and
questions.D: the Word was God
questions.explanation: The same Word became flesh and dwelt among us.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.topic: The Birth and Early Ministry of Jesus
questions.q: When Herod sought the child Jesus, an angel warned Joseph to flee to Egypt, and Herod, in his rage, killed all the male children of Bethlehem. The sorrow is described as
questions.D: Hannah refusing to eat
questions.explanation: The voice was heard in Ramah, weeping and loud lamentation.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: In 1 Corinthians 15, Paul explains that what is sown in the ground is a perishable body, and what is raised is
questions.A: a spirit with no body at all
questions.B: exactly the same body that died
questions.D: a body subject to decay again
questions.explanation: The seed dies; the harvest is glorious.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: 'Forgetting what lies behind and straining forward to what lies ahead, I press on toward the goal.' Paul wrote these words in his letter to the
questions.D: Philippians
questions.explanation: The runner keeps his eye on the prize.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: In the book of Revelation, the risen Christ describes himself as
questions.D: the first of the seven
questions.explanation: The first and last letters own the whole story.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: During the reign of Hezekiah, the Assyrian king who mocked the God of Judah and whose army was destroyed by the angel of the Lord in a single night was
questions.D: Shalmaneser the fifth
questions.explanation: In the morning, the camp held only dead men.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: When a woman known as a sinner washed Jesus' feet with her tears, wiped them with her hair and anointed them with ointment in the house of Simon the Pharisee, Jesus declared that
questions.B: she must first repay all she owed
questions.D: her many sins were forgiven, for she loved much
questions.explanation: Love answered where the Pharisee saw only fault.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: A woman who had suffered a flow of blood for twelve years came up behind Jesus in the crowd and touched the fringe of his garment, and
questions.B: her flow of blood stopped at once
questions.D: Jesus sent her to the priests
questions.explanation: 'Your faith has made you well.'

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: James compares the tongue to a small rudder that steers a great ship, and to a small fire that sets a forest ablaze, in order to teach that
questions.A: speech should never be used at all
questions.C: the tongue, though small, can do great harm or great good
questions.D: big things are always better than small ones
questions.explanation: A tiny helm turns a huge vessel.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: In the book of Revelation, John sees 'a new heaven and a new earth', and God declares that
questions.A: the nations will be scattered for ever
questions.B: the sea will cover the whole earth
questions.C: the old city will be rebuilt on the old site
questions.D: he will wipe away every tear, and death shall be no more
questions.explanation: The former things have passed away.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: When Moses asked God's name at the burning bush, to tell the people of Israel who had sent him, God answered
questions.C: 'I AM THE GOD OF ABRAHAM ONLY'
questions.D: 'MY NAME IS HIDDEN'
questions.explanation: The self-existing One needs no other name.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: The law of Moses provided that every fiftieth year, liberty should be proclaimed throughout the land and every Israelite should return to his own property. That year was the
questions.D: year of Passover
questions.explanation: The trumpet sounded, and the land rested.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: When two women both claimed the same living child, Solomon ordered that the child be divided in two with a sword. The true mother was revealed because she
questions.A: chose to give up the child
questions.D: offered the king a bribe
questions.explanation: Real love would rather lose than see harm.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: When the Pharisees asked Jesus whether it was lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, he asked whose image was on the coin, and then said
questions.A: 'Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's'
questions.B: 'Pay no tax at all to any foreign king'
questions.C: 'Give all that you have to Caesar first'
questions.D: 'The coin belongs wholly to the temple'
questions.explanation: The image on the coin settles the coin's duty.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: At the tomb of his friend Lazarus, when Jesus saw Mary weeping, the shortest verse of the gospels records that
questions.D: Jesus prayed
questions.explanation: Two words carry the whole heart of the Lord.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: 'Do not give dogs what is holy, and do not throw your pearls before pigs.' In this saying, the pearls stand for
questions.B: money given to the poor at the gate
questions.D: the harvest of the sea of Galilee
questions.explanation: Some gifts are trampled by those who cannot value them.

questions.subject: Christian Religious Studies
questions.q: 'Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.' This promise teaches that
questions.B: prayer must be made only once
questions.C: God's door is shut to all
questions.D: asking is forbidden to children
questions.explanation: The door opens to the hand that keeps knocking.
